audit.why: Lane difficulty 6/10 EVEN matches the 48.35% win rate over 1336 games; Renekton owns levels 2-3 and 6, Urgot owns 2+ items.

Spikes recorded: Renekton levels 2-3 (full pattern), Dominus at 6 (120/100/80s), Eclipse first item, 2-item side lane. Urgot spikes on Disdain rank-ups (16s down to 14s), 6 (Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s) and 2 items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Disdain (E) shields Urgot, or that Renekton's empowered W explicitly destroys damage shields on the target.
audit.why: Riot's text: Disdain 'charges in a direction, shielding himself'; Renekton W at 50+ Fury 'slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target'. That is the decisive interaction of the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Disdain shields him and flips you; empowered W (50 Fury) destroys that shield and stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Disdain's cooldown is 16s at rank 1 falling to 14s at rank 5 — that gap is the engage window.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d under the heading 'Get hit by his E' talked about burning your own cooldown — wrong subject.
audit.why: The don't should describe what Disdain does to you.
audit.corrected: Disdain flips you into his Purge arc and shields him — bait it first.

edits.before: E-in at level 2 lets you land empowered W before Urgot can Disdain-flip you; his flip has a reaction-time window you must beat.
edits.after: E-in at level 2 lets you land empowered W before Urgot can Disdain-flip you; empowered W also destroys the shield his Disdain grants.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then W-stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Dodge it, then W-stun. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Disdain (E) shields him; empowered W (50 fury) destroys that shield and stuns 1.5s — bait E, then commit.
